options.text: full of light or very smart
giving attention so nothing gets hurt

items.explanation: Bright means full of light, like a sunny morning. The other choices name different ideas.

items.prompt: Which word means 'giving attention so nothing gets hurt'?
items.explanation: The clue 'so nothing gets hurt' matches careful. Bright, honest, and strong name different ideas.

options.text: An honest child returns the lost wallet.
The sun is bright this morning.
Be careful when you carry the glass.
The strong man lifted the heavy sack.

items.explanation: An honest person tells the truth, so returning a lost wallet shows honesty.

items.prompt: Which word fits in this sentence: 'The ___ light hurt my eyes.'
items.explanation: A very bright light can hurt your eyes, so bright fits the sentence.

items.prompt: Find the word that means 'having power or force'.
items.explanation: Strong means having power or force, like a strong person lifting something heavy.
